verdict.rationale: Claude's Research feature runs multiple agentic searches that build on each other and returns answers with easy-to-check citations, which covers the grounding-with-citations core of the story. The docs never explicitly say the searches cover the current public web or how fresh the results are. One community user reports Claude's research depth trails competitors, which tempers confidence but does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation that searches cover live/current web results, detail on how citations link back to source URLs, independent hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: With research, Claude delivers thorough answers in minutes, complete with easy-to-check citations so you can trust Claude's findings.
Claude operates agentically, conducting multiple searches that build on each other while determining exactly what to investigate next.
Works pretty nicely for research still
